baseline_xgboost.name: Baseline XGBoost (Legacy)
baseline_xgboost.leakage_details: Includes post-settlement balance residuals (errorBalanceOrig, errorBalanceDest) and random stratified split.

preauth_xgboost.name: Pre-Authorization XGBoost (Champion)
preauth_xgboost.leakage_details: Exclusively pre-authorization features; zero post-settlement columns; time-aware chronological split.
preauth_xgboost.split_strategy: Chronological (Train: Days 1-24, Val: Days 25-27, Test OOT: Days 28-31)
preauth_xgboost.threshold_selection: Strictly tuned on Validation set to maximize F1

fastai_tabular.name: FastAI Tabular Neural Network (Benchmark)
fastai_tabular.leakage_details: Exact same 16 pre-auth features; Categorify & Normalize fit on train split only; same chronological test.
fastai_tabular.architecture: MLP [200, 100] with Entity Embeddings, BatchNorm & Dropout
fastai_tabular.split_strategy: Chronological (Train: Days 1-24 subset, Val: Days 25-27, Test OOT: Days 28-31)
fastai_tabular.threshold_selection: Strictly tuned on Validation set to maximize F1
